provenance: AI-written supplementary evaluation set (Claude), not an independent human-written blind set. Used once after configuration and threshold were frozen; never used for training or model selection.

thresholdPolicy.reason: Among fixed 0.00-0.95 (step 0.05) grid thresholds meeting 90% accepted accuracy and minimum support on role-filtered validation, maximize coverage; tie chooses lower threshold.
